neighbours.label: A data-structure description in code comments or docstrings (X is a list of (...), Index of A to B, Mapping between ...), firing on the container word or the structure literal, vs code comments that describe actions with no container
fire:

        sessions = fetch()

    cache = {}

        self.servers = {}
:param list pairs: List of (source, target) node tuples

    queue = []

quiet:
# Sessions expire after one hour
        sessions = fetch()

# Look up the username before login
        self.check()
:param str route: Url pattern that the handler should answer

# cache results to speed up repeated calls
    cache.clear()

# Connect to the nearest server first
        self.connect()
:param int count: Number of retries before giving up

# QUEUE is processed every five seconds
    process()

# Report the device status to the server
        self.report()
